structural_history_boundaries.barrier_reason: Inception date of XLC (Communication Services Select Sector SPDR). Before this date, XLC did not exist.
structural_history_boundaries.secondary_reason: Inception date of XLRE (Real Estate Select Sector SPDR).
structural_history_boundaries.leveraged_reason: Inception date of ProShares Ultra QQQ (QLD) and ProShares Ultra S&P500 (SSO).
structural_history_boundaries.recommended_full_universe_window: 2018-07-02 to 2026-07-06 (8.0 calendar years of continuous 24-symbol coverage)

market_calendar_and_session_alignment.missing_session_policy: Strict validation against exchange calendar. Gaps due to market holidays (e.g. Good Friday, Memorial Day) allowed; unscheduled session dropouts trigger alert.

adjustment_and_leakage_control.split_adjustment: Backward ratio adjustment applied to prices (open, high, low, close) and inverse to volume. Preserves percentage returns across splits without artificial gaps.
adjustment_and_leakage_control.dividend_policy: Raw unadjusted prices maintained alongside split-adjusted prices. To prevent lookahead leakage, cash dividends are credited to cash balance on ex-dividend date during backtest replay rather than retroactively adjusting historical price series.
adjustment_and_leakage_control.point_in_time_safety: Bars delivered to agent.decide() at date T close strictly contain historical observations through session T close. Execution fills at session T+1 open price + slippage.

storage_architecture_and_git_hygiene.local_storage_path: data_cache/daily_bars_24.parquet (ONLY permitted if using Tiingo Power /mo or Polygon Developer /mo; STRICTLY FORBIDDEN on Tiingo Free/Starter)
storage_architecture_and_git_hygiene.git_status: Strictly git-ignored via .gitignore line 9 (data_cache/) and line 10 (*.parquet)
storage_architecture_and_git_hygiene.credential_isolation: API keys stored in root .env (git-ignored via .gitignore line 5). Zero credentials committed.
storage_architecture_and_git_hygiene.free_tier_storage_rule: If Tiingo Free/Starter tier is selected, data MUST be streamed via InMemoryStreamProvider with zero persistent disk artifacts.

provider_qualification_and_costs.suitability: RECOMMENDED (Full 2018-2026 coverage, point-in-time splits/dividends, internal disk caching authorized under Section 1.6)

provider_qualification_and_costs.limits: Unlimited requests/minute, flat files S3 access
provider_qualification_and_costs.suitability: VIABLE (Institutional-grade SIP consolidated data; higher cost at /mo)

provider_qualification_and_costs.suitability: CONDITIONAL (Viable ONLY via InMemoryStreamProvider; zero disk persistence allowed under Section 1.6; rate limits require throttled ingestion)
INSUFFICIENT (Fails 8-year target window requirement; cannot cover 2018-2021)

user_decisions_required_before_b2: Select primary data acquisition strategy: (A) Paid Tiingo Power (/mo, allows local parquet caching) vs (B) Free Tiingo streaming (zero disk cache, transient RAM only) vs (C) Paid Polygon Developer (/mo).
Authorize credential configuration in git-ignored .env file.
Select dividend payment date policy: REJECT (strict) vs IMPUTE_SETTLEMENT_LAG (+14 days).

META.provider_handling: Query as META; historical bars pre-June 2022 aliased from FB.

GOOGL.distinction: Class A voting shares (IPO 2004); distinguished from GOOG (Class C non-voting created April 2014).

ticker_aliases_and_corporate_events.dividend_payment_date_policy: Strict policy: if historical payment date is missing (e.g. pre-2023 Tiingo), PaymentDatePolicy.REJECT prevents silent ex-date substitution; fallback requires documented PaymentDatePolicy.IMPUTE_SETTLEMENT_LAG (+14 days).
